title: Angry Birds Dream Blast takes you back to the Angry Birds Movie 2 in new event
summary: With the Angry Birds Movie 3 set to land in cinemas soon, it's no surprise that Rovio are eager to get people back in the silver screen mood. And now Angry Birds Dream Blast is throwing you back to the original sequel, with a new in-game event devoted to the Angry Birds Movie 2. The event will see you play through content inspired by the Angry Birds Movie 2 and relive the events of the film for yourself. It also sees the introduction of the Dream Album mechanic, which lets you earn even more rewards themed around the film for completing levels. All in all, a great way to prep yourself for the new film with the new Dream Album available for the next 28 days. ... [MORE]

title: Delta Force has you dodging riptides and throwing shields in their newest season, Aurora
summary: Delta Force, Timi Studio Group and Team Jade's popular tactical shooter, is getting a major suite of new content today. The launch of Delta Force's latest update, Season Aurora, comes packed with a new operator, map and plenty of quality-of-life fixes, which means you'll definitely want to log in and have a go! Of course, the major feature here is the new Operator. And Veronica Cardozo, codename: Martelo, is certainly hard to miss, especially when she's smashing her bulletproof shield into your face. Able to charge forward with her shield to clear enemies, fire smoke grenades, and grow stronger with the intensity of the fight, Martelo is perfect if you like to get up close and personal. ... [MORE]

title: Gobs & Gears turns factory building into a goblin-powered demolition puzzle
summary: The best advice Gobs & Gears gives you is to build it wrong. It may sound counterintuitive, but you lay out a route, rip it up the moment it’s done its job, and blow up the odd building along the way, all to finish a bomb for a goblin king who wants it immediately. It’s a logistics puzzler that’s out now on iPhone. The map starts under a thick Fog. Just like London has been the past few days. You put up Scout Towers to burn it back in bursts, and each surge reveals lost Buildings that need to be brought back. For that, you need the right resources, which must be hauled around by Trundlers along conveyor routes you lay yourself. And if a mountain gets in your way, just blow it up. ... [MORE]

title: Game of Thrones: Dragonfire now lets you build your own team of capable Commanders
summary: With the airing of House of the Dragon, Game of Thrones is roaring back to popularity in a big way. So it should be no surprise that Warner Bros. Games is giving Game of Thrones: Dragonfire, the mobile spinoff, the lion's share of attention. And now, your journey to dominate Westeros is getting assistance in the form of Commanders. If you've ever played a mobile RTS/RPG mashup, you'll know what to expect from Commanders. These individual characters can be collected and assigned to lead your force, with their distinctive abilities either buffing your own units or debuffing those of the foe, as well as synergising with the signature dragons of Dragonfire. ... title: Hillthorn, the card-based detective sim, is out now on iOS and Android
summary: Even if Halloween is done and dusted, the November nights are drawing in, making it perfect for something spooky to play. And if that's the mood that's taking you, then publisher Raw Fury and developer Fool Moon's latest release that's just landed for iOS and Android, Hillthorn, should be more than enough in the way of chills and thrills. Hillthorn is a card-based detective sim, where you take on the role of investigating a mysterious community and the case of a disappeared child. With time in short supply, and the maze-like trails of Hillthorn Mountain threatening to swallow you whole (perhaps literally), there's not long to find out whodunnit and why. ... [MORE]

title: Chasing Kaleidorider launches sign-ups for its Doki test closed beta
summary: Of all the upcoming Tencent releases, I think one of the strangest has been Fizzglee's  Chasing Kaleidorider. Described as a doki doki romance, it'd be easy to dismiss it as just another dumb waifu game. But with sign-ups now open for their Doki test, that is to say, closed beta, you may find yourself surprised. All this featuring colourful character designs and enemies to do battle with on the open road. ... [MORE]

title: Warhammer Survivors sees the grimdark future take on the Vampire Survivors formula, out now
summary: With Warhammer having gone from a niche tabletop board game to a bona fide cultural phenomenon, that popularity also brings dozens of video game spinoffs. But Auroch Digital aren't going the shooter or strategy route, as today their long-awaited collaboration with Poncle lands on iOS and Android, as Warhammer Survivors launches for mobile! Warhammer Survivors sees the Vampire Survivors format translated both to the universe of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar. As iconic characters from both series, you'll fight your way through hordes of enemies, across a variety of stages, and take on powerful bosses with increasingly ludicrous, game-changing weaponry of your own. ... title: Kettle Street sends you searching for a missing cat in its new Missing Abra event
summary: Where’s Wally (Waldo, if you grew up in the US) only works because everyone’s staring at the same page, so someone can point and the rest of you can pretend you’d nearly got there. Kettle Street, the cosy British life sim, is taking a page out of that book for their latest event, Missing Abra. Claire’s calico cat has gone missing somewhere in town, and you need to help find it. You find her by wandering Kettleby, and once you spot her, you take a photo with a new camera. She hides somewhere different in each person’s town, though. A mate who found her yesterday can’t tell you where yours is, and neither can we. No guides will help with this one. ... [MORE]

title: Talesweaver Mobile is Nexon's new MMO coming to Korea
summary: It would seem Nexon aren't content with just launching Temppal: Overgeared soon in certain regions, because they have another MMORPG on the cards too. TalesWeaver Mobile is another adaptation of a popular IP, and it's set to make its way to mobile in Korea, with sign-ups for its closed testing period now open. TalesWeaver originally launched in 2003 as an online RPG, a genre that was extremely popular in Korea and that gave rise to other hits such as MapleStory. This new spinoff takes you back to the world first outlined in Jeon Min-hee's novel Children of the Rune, with the familiar mix of fantastical world and colourful graphics. ... [MORE]

title: The Roottrees are Dead has you investigating a complex family tree with 90s technology
summary: Mystery games tend to fall into very familiar divisions, with point-and-click adventures or hidden-object puzzlers as you attempt to unpack a mystery, such as a murder or disappearance. But The Roottrees are Dead offers a very different take on the format as it launches for iOS and Android, complete with an extra mystery! The Roottrees are Dead sees the story kick off with the deaths of the titular wealthy family, and your introduction in the role of investigator. Your job is not to figure out what killed them; that's already clear, but instead you have to track down their various relatives who, thanks to the wishes of an eccentric patriarch, are now entitled to a share of the enormous Roottree fortune. ... [MORE]

title: WB All-Star Mayhem is a new multiverse mashup RPG from Kabam featuring Warner Bros. icons
summary: Nowadays, crossovers are all the rage, be it in movies, comic books or television. And gaming is no different! Now, Kabam are set to tackle the back catalogue of one of entertainment's biggest companies, as WB All-Star Mayhem has been announced for iOS and Android! Set to start limited regional testing this month, WB All-Star Mayhem is a mobile RPG that sees the likes of everything from Adventure Time, Steven Universe, Samurai Jack and Scooby-Doo! cross over, as Animaniac's megalomaniacal mouse Brain gets his hands on a universal remote, with the intention of taking over each universe in turn unless someone puts a stop to him! ... [MORE]

title: Absolum launches on mobile bringing side-scrolling fantasy action to the palm of your hand
summary: Been on the lookout for an exciting new release to play on mobile? Want to pit fantasy freedom fighters against the forces of an oppressive regime? Been following the site for the past few weeks? Then you probably already know that Absolum, the side-scrolling Golden Axe-like, now available to purchase on iOS and Android! Absolum takes you to the fantasy world of Talamh which has been devasted by magical disasters. The Sun King Azra has used this as an excuse to imprison and enslave magic-users, leaving only you and your band of freedom fighters to push back against him and his Crimson Order. ... [MORE]
